Definition: military equipment, i.e. (collectively) arms (offensive or defensive), or (concretely) an arsenal
BiblicalUsage: Armour is the gear of kings and captains, brought year by year to Solomon as tribute, counted among the strength of a fenced city, and stored in the armoury by the wall of Jerusalem. It is wealth, it is readiness, and it is the wall's last line.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that armour kept in the armoury is armour waiting for its hour — and the wall of Jerusalem was rebuilt with the armoury still standing. Solomon's armour came as tribute, and Nehemiah's armoury stood by the wall — both of them wait for the day they are needed.
